PREFIX i: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/iso15531#>
PREFIX e: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/iso14040#>
PREFIX c: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/core#>
PREFIX a: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/alignment#>
PREFIX t: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/research#>
PREFIX p: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/paint-ext#>
PREFIX r: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/resource#>
PREFIX f: <http://w3id.org/protys/fixture#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
# Q06 Intensidad de emisiones eléctricas del proceso productivo en kg CO2e/L
SELECT ?product ?lot ?liters (SUM(?ghg) AS ?ghgKgCO2e)
((SUM(?ghg) / ?liters) AS ?kgCO2ePerL) WHERE {
{ SELECT ?lot ?op (MIN(?inputEnergy) AS ?energy)
(MIN(?inputGHG) AS ?ghg) WHERE {
?lot a i:Lot ; i:hasProcess ?process ; i:hasActivity ?op .
?op a i:ProcessOperation ; i:partOfProcess ?process .
?lot t:hasGHGContribution ?op .
?op i:consumesEnergyKWh ?inputEnergy .
FILTER(isNumeric(?inputEnergy) && ?inputEnergy >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?op i:consumesEnergyKWh ?rowEnergyOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?rowEnergyOther) || ?rowEnergyOther != ?inputEnergy) }
?op t:hasEmissionFactor ?rowFactor .
FILTER(isIRI(?rowFactor))
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?op t:hasEmissionFactor ?rowOtherFactor .
FILTER(!sameTerm(?rowOtherFactor,?rowFactor)) }
?rowFactor a t:ElectricityEmissionFactor ; t:factorUnit "kg CO2e/kWh" .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?rowFactor t:factorUnit ?rowOtherUnit .
FILTER(STR(?rowOtherUnit) != "kg CO2e/kWh") }
?rowFactor t:factorValue ?rowFactorValue .
FILTER(isNumeric(?rowFactorValue) && ?rowFactorValue >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?rowFactor t:factorValue ?rowFactorOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?rowFactorOther) || ?rowFactorOther != ?rowFactorValue) }
?op e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?inputGHG .
FILTER(isNumeric(?inputGHG) && ?inputGHG >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?op e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?rowGHGOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?rowGHGOther) || ?rowGHGOther != ?inputGHG) }
FILTER(ABS(?inputGHG - ?inputEnergy * ?rowFactorValue) <= 0.000000001)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?lot a i:Lot ; i:hasProcess ?allProcess ; i:hasActivity ?allOperation .
?allOperation a i:ProcessOperation ; i:partOfProcess ?allProcess .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation i:consumesEnergyKWh ?allEnergy .
FILTER(isNumeric(?allEnergy) && ?allEnergy >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation i:consumesEnergyKWh ?allCheckEnergyOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?allCheckEnergyOther) || ?allCheckEnergyOther != ?allEnergy) }
?allOperation t:hasEmissionFactor ?allCheckFactor .
FILTER(isIRI(?allCheckFactor))
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation t:hasEmissionFactor ?allCheckOtherFactor .
FILTER(!sameTerm(?allCheckOtherFactor,?allCheckFactor)) }
?allCheckFactor a t:ElectricityEmissionFactor ; t:factorUnit "kg CO2e/kWh" .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allCheckFactor t:factorUnit ?allCheckOtherUnit .
FILTER(STR(?allCheckOtherUnit) != "kg CO2e/kWh") }
?allCheckFactor t:factorValue ?allCheckFactorValue .
FILTER(isNumeric(?allCheckFactorValue) && ?allCheckFactorValue >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allCheckFactor t:factorValue ?allCheckFactorOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?allCheckFactorOther) || ?allCheckFactorOther != ?allCheckFactorValue) }
?allOperation e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?allGHG .
FILTER(isNumeric(?allGHG) && ?allGHG >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?allCheckGHGOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?allCheckGHGOther) || ?allCheckGHGOther != ?allGHG) }
FILTER(ABS(?allGHG - ?allEnergy * ?allCheckFactorValue) <= 0.000000001) } }
}
GROUP BY ?lot ?op }
?lot t:producesProduct ?product ; i:functionalUnit "L" .
{ SELECT ?lot (MIN(?rawLiters) AS ?liters) WHERE { ?lot i:producesQuantity ?rawLiters .
FILTER(isNumeric(?rawLiters) && ?rawLiters > 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?lot i:producesQuantity ?volumeOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?volumeOther) || ?volumeOther != ?rawLiters) } } GROUP BY ?lot }
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?lot i:functionalUnit ?otherUnit . FILTER(STR(?otherUnit)!="L") }
} GROUP BY ?product ?lot ?liters ORDER BY ?lot
